description: Search the Juggle sitters (babysitters, petsitters, nannies — college-student 'Squad') in your city: name, location, rating, jobs completed, background check, whether they are a favorite and how many of your friends booked them. Optional filters: available on a date between start_time and end_time, services, keywords, name. Returns profileId (for juggle_get_sitter) and accountId (for favorites, reviews and booking invites). Use juggle_list_favorites for just your favorites.

date.description: Only sitters available on this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Needs start_time and end_time.

limit.description: How many sitters to return (default 20, max 200).

view.description: Response shape: "compact" (default) drops fields the response already carries elsewhere; "full" returns every field this server understands; "raw" returns the upstream payload unprojected. compact: ids, name, location, rating, jobs completed, background check, favorite, friends. "full" returns the upstream sitter items and the filter echo; "raw" the whole page data.

name: juggle_list_sitters
title: Find / search Juggle sitters
